item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 28 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 28-Final #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 5:00 AM, 20 August 2026(Thursday)

Light to moderate rains was observed over Zambales and Bataan for the past 3 hours. With this development all RAINFALL WARNING in these areas are now terminated.
Meanwhile, light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Bataan(Morong, Bagac) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are still advised to MONITOR the weather condition.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to www.pagasa.dost.gov.ph.

item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 27 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 27 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 2:00 AM, 20 August 2026(Thursday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Zambales and Bataan.
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.


Meanwhile, expect light to moderate rains over Bulacan(Dona Remedios Trinidad, San Miguel, San Ildefonso, Hagonoy, Calumpit, Paombong, Pulilan, Malolos, Baliuag, San Rafael) within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Pampanga(Floridablanca, Porac, Lubao, Santa Rita, Guagua, Angeles, Mabalacat, Bacolor, Magalang, Sasmuan, Macabebe, Minalin, Masantol), Tarlac(Bamban, Capas, San Jose, Mayantoc, Santa Ignacia, Camiling, San Clemente, Paniqui, Moncada, San Manuel, Anao, Ramos, Gerona, Pura) and Nueva Ecija(Nampicuan, Cuyapo, Carranglan, Pantabangan, San Jose, Lupao, Talugtug, Guimba, Munoz) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 5:00 AM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to www.pagasa.dost.gov.ph.

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #NCR_PRSD
Issued at: 3:25 AM, 20 August 2026(Thursday)

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over Metro Manila(Malabon, Navotas, Manila, Caloocan, Valenzuela, Quezon City), Bulacan(Meycauayan, Marilao, Santa Maria, Bocaue, Bulakan, Obando, Balagtas, Pandi, Guiguinto, Malolos, San Jose del Monte), Batangas(Nasugbu) and Cavite(Maragondon, Ternate, Magallanes, Naic) within the next 2 hours.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
